name: measured_20260918

command.method: Use positive rounded receive-interval excess above 20 ms as rare late-frame amplitudes and counts. Collapse nonpositive excess to zero. A delayed frame followed by a normal frame generates the compensating short interval automatically. This is a late-event approximation, not an identified one-way latency distribution.

feedback.method: Use positive rounded ACK roundtrip excess above the existing 20 ms feedback schedule. Collapse 19/20 ms observations to zero extra delay; do not advance feedback or add another 20 ms. ACK confirms reception, not causal motor response.

limitations: Independent per-frame late-event sampling does not reproduce all temporal correlations or identify fixed one-way latency.
Command and feedback histograms are from different capture windows and are sampled independently.
One batched frame shares a delay across motors and environments.
Captures used constant position and gain commands; coverage under policy computation load is not established.
